headline: Lagos Governor Challenges Nigerian Banks to Deploy Recapitalization Funds into Job Creation
summary: Lagos State Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu urged Nigerian banks to channel N4.65 trillion raised through recent recapitalization exercises into financing industries, expanding businesses, and creating jobs.
why: Banking sector recapitalization in Nigeria is designed to strengthen financial institutions' balance sheets and increase lending capacity to spur broader economic development.

impacts.name: Nigerian Banking Sector
impacts.why: Directing newly capitalized funds into industrial loans impacts banks' asset allocation and credit portfolios.
